readmeAsData:
ROYAL THRONE — GAMEPLAY ASSETS
==============================
77 separate lossless WEBP sprites with alpha transparency.

CONTENTS
01_match_pieces   5 basic matching pieces: crown, shield, red block, green leaf, magenta crystal.
02_powerups       5 boosters: horizontal rocket, vertical rocket, barrel bomb, propeller, color ball.
03_grass          3 grass states: full tile, hollow border, partially cleared border.
04_board          11 quiet board tiles, a hollow gold frame, and individual frame slices.
05_effects        42 burst groups, individual fragments, sparkles, a clear ring, a hit flash and two line flashes.
06_optional_extras 11 optional royal objects, obstacles, a coin and booster alternatives.

LAYOUT
- Most pieces and overlays use a 512 x 512 transparent canvas and a centered pivot.
- Basic matching pieces fit within approximately 430 x 430 pixels.
- Individual fragments use 128 x 128; individual sparkles use 256 x 256.
- Trails and frame parts have rectangular/native slice dimensions. See manifest.json.
- Core sprites contain no labels or colored rectangular backdrops.
- Board cells and grass are intentionally filled within their tile silhouettes.

LAYERING
Board cell -> grass_full -> matching piece -> foreground VFX.
The hollow grass border is an optional overlay. Do not draw every grass state at once.
The frame has a transparent center; suggested nine-slice borders are 40 px on each side.
Stretch straight frame edges only along their long axis; keep the corners un-stretched.

SOURCE AND RESOLUTION
The main artwork was generated for this pack; the reference screenshots were not cut up
and reused as sprites. Plain board cells and frame geometry are separately authored.
Generated atlas objects are roughly 180-256 pixels across. The 512-pixel versions are
normalized/upscaled exports, not native 512-pixel renders. Inspect at your actual cell size.

STATIC ARTWORK
These are static sprites, not a complete game or a set of animation frames. Propeller
rotation, rocket travel, cascades, particle emission, timings and sound are not included.
The partial grass border is a static state, not a tested damage progression.
No engine-specific import settings, prefabs or native 3D models are included.

FILES
manifest.json lists dimensions, visible bounds, sources and checksums for every WEBP.
The preview sheets show exported assets; they are not textures intended for import.
